## 1.0 Platform Overview

Platform tools provide the foundational technology infrastructure for governance execution, enabling:

- **Centralized Workflow Management** - Automated routing and approval processes
- **Document Management** - Version control and centralized storage
- **Collaboration & Communication** - Team coordination and stakeholder engagement
- **Reporting & Analytics** - Governance metrics and performance tracking
- **Integration Capabilities** - Seamless data flow between systems
- **Audit Trail & Compliance** - Complete governance activity logging

### 2.1 Azure DevOps Boards

**Purpose**: Agile project management for EA practice backlog and Kanban workflow management

**Key Capabilities**:

- **Backlog Management** - Prioritized work item tracking and sprint planning
- **Kanban Boards** - Visual workflow management with customizable swim lanes
- **Work Item Tracking** - User stories, tasks, bugs, and feature tracking
- **Sprint Planning** - Agile iteration planning and capacity management
- **Burndown Charts** - Progress tracking and velocity measurements
- **Custom Workflows** - Tailored process templates for EA governance activities
- **Integration APIs** - Connect with GitHub, ServiceNow, and other development tools
- **Reporting Dashboards** - Agile metrics and team performance analytics

**Governance Use Cases**:

- **EA Initiative Backlog** - Prioritized list of architecture initiatives and improvements
- **Governance Process Enhancement** - Track governance framework improvements and updates
- **Standards Development** - Manage technical standards creation and review cycles
- **Assessment Activity Tracking** - Monitor architecture review and assessment progress
- **Training Program Management** - Plan and track EA training and certification activities
- **Tool Integration Projects** - Manage platform integration and automation initiatives

**Board Configuration**:

- **EA Backlog Board** - Master backlog for all EA practice initiatives
- **Governance Kanban** - Workflow for governance process improvements
- **Standards Development** - Track technical standards creation and updates
- **Assessment Pipeline** - Architecture review and assessment workflow
- **Training & Onboarding** - Team development and knowledge management activities

**Integration Points**:

- **GitHub Integration** - Link work items to repositories and pull requests
- **ServiceNow Connection** - Sync governance requests with ADO work items
- **SharePoint Integration** - Link documentation and collaboration artifacts
- **Teams Integration** - Embedded boards in Microsoft Teams channels

- **Reporting Dashboards** - Real-time governance metrics and KPIs
- **Integration APIs** - Connectivity with other enterprise systems

- Gate process submissions and approvals
- Exception request tracking

- Approval matrices and escalation rules

- Integration with Active Directory for authentication

### 2.4 GitHub Enterprise

**Purpose**: Host reference architecture repository and AI governance and interaction tools platform

**Key Capabilities**:

- **Reference Architecture Repository** - Central hosting for EA reference architecture documentation and artifacts
- **AI Governance Tools Platform** - Host AI-powered governance and interaction tools
- **Version Control** - Complete change history for all governance artifacts and AI models
- **Collaborative Editing** - Multi-author document development with AI-enhanced workflows
- **Issue Tracking** - Governance action item management with intelligent automation
- **Branch Management** - Controlled change processes for documentation and AI tool deployments
- **CI/CD Pipeline** - Automated deployment of reference architecture and AI governance tools

**Governance Use Cases**:

- **Architecture Decision Record (ADR) management** - Centralized decision documentation
- **Governance framework maintenance** - Complete governance process documentation
- **Standards and guidelines version control** - Technical standards management
- **Assessment template library** - Standardized evaluation frameworks
- **Policy and procedure collaboration** - Multi-author governance document development
- **Product architecture documentation** - Product-specific EA artifacts
- **Training material management** - Educational content version control
- **Infrastructure as Code governance** - IaC template and deployment standards
- **Change tracking across all EA artifacts** - Complete audit trail for all changes

**Repository Structure**:

```text
eap-ref-architecture/
├── decisions/             # Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
├── foundation/            # Core EA practice framework and processes
├── governance/            # Governance framework, policies, and procedures
│   ├── committees/        # Governance committee structures and charters
│   ├── framework/         # Overall governance framework documentation
│   ├── governing-bodies/  # Review boards and decision-making bodies
│   ├── metrics/           # Governance KPIs and measurement frameworks
│   ├── policies/          # Enterprise architecture policies
│   ├── processes/         # Governance processes and workflows
│   └── tools/             # Platform tools and technology documentation
├── guidance               # EA best practices and guidance documents
├── guiding-principles/    # Enterprise architecture guiding principles
├── job-descriptions/      # EA role definitions and career progression
├── onboarding/            # New team member onboarding materials
├── patterns/              # Reusable architecture patterns
├── business-portfolio/              # Product-specific architecture documentation
├── rcas/                  # Root Cause Analysis templates and processes
├── standards/             # Technical standards and guidelines
├── strategy/              # EA strategy and roadmap documentation
├── templates/             # Document templates and assessment tools
└── training/              # Educational materials and certification paths
```

### 3.2 Data Flow & Synchronization

**Automated Publication Workflows**:

- **LeanIX → Python Extract Jobs**: Scheduled Python jobs extract architecture portfolio data via LeanIX APIs
- **Python Extract Jobs → GitHub Ref Arch Repo**: Processed data published to GitHub repository in structured formats (JSON, YAML, Markdown)
- **Synthesia → GitHub Ref Arch Repo**: Video content published directly to GitHub repository
- **GitHub Ref Arch Repo → Reference Architecture Portal**: GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline automatically builds and deploys to EKS cluster
- **MKDocs Compilation**: Documentation compilation with portfolio data and automatically embedded video content
- **Video Integration**: Videos automatically appear in MKDocs documentation and sync to Reference Architecture Portal
- **EKS Deployment**: Containerized knowledge base deployment to Kubernetes with health checks

**Cross-Platform Data Flows**:

- **LeanIX → GitHub**: Architecture portfolio data extracted via Python jobs and published to GitHub repository
- **Synthesia → GitHub**: Video content published directly to GitHub repository
- **GitHub → Reference Architecture Portal**: Automated CI/CD pipeline builds and deploys content to the live portal with embedded videos

**Video Content Integration Workflow**:

- **Video Creation**: Manual video production using Synthesia based on EA content and training needs
- **GitHub Publication**: Synthesia publishes completed videos directly to GitHub repositories
- **Automated Pipeline**: GitHub Actions automatically processes and deploys video content to knowledge base
- **Multi-Platform Distribution**: Videos automatically appear in MKDocs documentation and sync to SharePoint

**GitHub Ref Arch Repo CI/CD Pipeline**:

- **Trigger Events**: Repository changes from Python extracts, Synthesia videos, or manual documentation updates
- **Data Processing**: Automated processing of LeanIX portfolio data extracts into documentation formats
- **Content Validation**: Automated markdown linting, link checking, and content validation
- **Portfolio Integration**: Dynamic integration of architecture data into documentation pages and diagrams
- **MKDocs Build**: Site compilation with custom themes, plugins, data visualizations, and embedded videos
- **EKS Deployment**: Automated containerized deployment to Kubernetes cluster with health checks
- **Notification System**: Email notifications for successful deployments and failures

**Python Extract Jobs Details**:

- **Scheduled Execution**: Automated daily/weekly extraction jobs using cron scheduling
- **API Integration**: Python scripts leveraging LeanIX REST APIs and GraphQL endpoints
- **Data Transformation**: Raw LeanIX data processed into documentation-ready formats
- **GitHub Integration**: Automated commits and pull requests for data updates
- **Error Handling**: Comprehensive logging, retry logic, and failure notifications
- **Data Validation**: Quality checks and schema validation before publishing

**LeanIX Data Extract Types**:

- **Application Portfolio**: Current state application inventory and relationships
- **Technology Stack**: Infrastructure and platform component data
- **Architecture Roadmaps**: Future state planning and migration timelines
- **Compliance Status**: Architecture governance compliance reporting data
- **Business Capabilities**: Business function mapping and capability models
- **Data Flows**: Inter-application data integration and dependencies
